title: Add compact-span compactor, token-bucket provenance index, and microtrace stitching
author: Priya Shah
description:
Context and motivation:
Long-tail invocations with many short-lived spans were causing high cardinality in our span-store and noisy per-token cost attributions. Teams running cost-sensitive workloads reported that existing sampled traces frequently missed small but expensive token hotspots (e.g. aggressive multi-tool reroutes), while dashboards were overloaded with near-duplicate short spans. This PR introduces a compact-span compactor, a token-bucket provenance index, and microtrace stitching to improve signal quality and reduce storage/ingest costs.

What this changes (high level):
- compact-span compactor: a lightweight component that deduplicates and coalesces sequences of short spans within an invocation into a compact microtrace representation. Compact microtraces retain timing buckets, aggregate token counts, and provenance markers but remove repeated low-entropy payloads.
- token-bucket provenance index: a per-invocation, per-segment index that attributes token cost to provenance labels (e.g. prompt-prefix, model-fallback, tool-call). Enables authoritative per-token cost rollups without needing full span payloads for every invocation.
- microtrace stitching: when a full sampled trace exists, compact microtraces are stitched into the trace summary UI so users can expand compressed segments on demand. This keeps storage low while preserving explorable context for root-cause.
- Dashboard: added "Token Provenance Lens" panels under Observability > Invocation Explorer and a compact microtrace timeline panel. Panels surface cost by provenance bucket and show compact vs full trace fidelity.
- Alerts/tuning: adjust the short-invocation SLO noise-suppression rule to ignore transient cost spikes where >80% of tokens are assigned to a single provenance bucket flagged as "ephemeral" (e.g. client-side retries).

Files changed (high level):
- telemetry/compactor/compactor.go (new): core compaction logic, eviction policy, and provenance tagging hooks.
- telemetry/index/token_provenance_index.go (new): lightweight index + query API used by dashboards and the cost rollup job.
- observability/ui/token_provenance_panel.yaml (new): dashboard panels + panel descriptions and sample queries.
- observability/alerts/short-invocation-noise-suppression.rule (modified): threshold and provenance bucket exemption.
- telemetry/ingest/stream_processor.go (modified): integrate compaction step into ingest pipeline (config guarded).
- ingestion/benchmarks/compactor_bench_test.go (new): microbench for compactor throughput and latency.
- docs/observability/token-provenance.md (new): operator guide and sample queries.
- tests/telemetry/compactor_integration_test.go (new): end-to-end test covering compaction + stitch + index query.
(and a few small refactors and wiring changes across telemetry and observability modules)

Commits (summary):
- 9c2e1a1: add compact-span compactor implementation and basic unit tests
- d7b3f2b: add token-bucket provenance index + query API
- 1e5a9c0: wire compactor into ingest pipeline behind feature flag
- 3b4f88d: dashboard panels and sample queries for token provenance lens
- 7f1a2b9: adjust alert rule for short-invocation noise suppression
- 0a4d6c7: add integration tests and benchmarks

Testing and CI:
- Local unit tests: compactor, index, and query shims added.
- Integration tests: compactor_integration_test covers sample ingestion, compaction, stitch, and index query path.
- Benchmarks: compactor_bench_test demonstrates <2ms median overhead per invocation under 500rps ingest in our test harness.
- CI: all checks passed on final run (unit, integration, lint, go vet).

Review notes and conversation (abridged):
- Ethan Park (review): "Nice compact representation — helps storage and the stitching UX is elegant. Two nits: make the compactor eviction policy pluggable, and add a metric for dropped payloads when compressing."
- Priya (author): "Made eviction policy into a small interface + default ring buffer in compactor.go; added telemetry.metrics.compactor.dropped_payloads and compactor.eviction_count."
- Lena Rodriguez (review): "I want to ensure provenance labels are stable and backward compatible with existing cost rollups. Can we add a migration shim?"
- Priya: "Added a compatibility layer in token_provenance_index.go that maps legacy provenance tags (legacy_tool, legacy_prompt) to the new canonical labels. Documented in docs/observability/token-provenance.md."
- Marco Silva (review): "Dashboard queries look expensive at scale. Please add a materialized rollup with TTL."
- Priya: "Added a background rollup job that builds per-hour provenance rollups for the dashboard with a 7-day TTL; query defaults to rollup path and falls back to index when needed."
- CI flake: one integration test failed initially due to a race in the test harness; fixed by adding deterministic clock to compactor for tests.

Operational impact and rollout plan:
- Feature flagged: compaction is off by default in production. Rollout plan: enable for 10% ingestion traffic for 48h (canary), then 50% for 72h monitoring compactor.eviction_count, dropped_payloads, and dashboard rollup freshness.
- Migration: index is additive; dashboards will read rollups first. No destructive migration required.
- Backwards compatibility: compatibility shim preserves legacy labels for existing dashboards and billing reconciliations.

Release notes (for patch/next release):
- Added compact-span compactor to reduce span-store cardinality and storage costs for short-lived spans.
- Introduced token-bucket provenance index to enable per-provenance token cost rollups.
- New dashboard: Token Provenance Lens and compact microtrace timeline.
- Alert tuning: short-invocation noise suppression updated to reduce false positives for ephemeral token spikes.

Follow-ups / open items:
- Add an ingestion-only mode to stream rollup job to further reduce query latency (ENG-4302).
- Investigate GPU-backed compaction for future lower-latency, higher-throughput paths.
- Product: consider adding provenance buckets to Billing exports (PM-128) — tracked in linked Linear.

Merge outcome:
- After two rounds of reviews and a passing CI (all checks green), this PR was squashed and merged to main on 2025-11-12.

Contact and ownership:
- Author: Priya Shah (@priyash) — telemetry team
- Primary reviewer / owner for rollout: Ethan Park (@ethanp) — SRE/observability

If you want to try it locally: follow docs/observability/token-provenance.md, enable feature flag `telemetry.compactor.enabled=true` and run the integration harness `./scripts/test_ingest_compactor.sh` to reproduce the canary ingest workload.
